system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

You take liquid metal and insert it into an open lock of a sealed or locked contraption. By spending 1 minute, you can perform the Pick Locks activity as if you have a Security Kit. When you do, reduce the DC by 10 as your try to reconfigure the locks internals to fit any key shape you are thinking. On a successful check, the lock is unlatched and any other key that would normally unlock the lock can no longer do so. Any key you have can now unlock or lock the lock as if it was the original key.
